The Land Yacht Is an Elegant Yet Roam-Ready Camper Van With a Nautical-Inspired Interior Design
17 photos
Photo: YouTube Screenshot / Activan
The marine and camper van industry have some similarities regarding how the vehicles are built and the design behind them. You can arguably call a camper van a "land yacht" – that's the name of the camper van I'd like to share with you today, given by its creator.
What we have here is a project based on an AWD Mercedes-Benz Sprinter with a 170" wheelbase. It's the latest creation made by Activan, a Reno, Nevada-based company specializing in roam-ready Sprinter camper vans.
As usual, let's first take a look at the exterior. This camper van, like all others by Activan, is designed to handle off-roading – and you can tell that as soon as you lay eyes on it.
For starters, it rides on Black Rhino wheels wrapped in BFGoodrich KO3 all-terrain tires. The company also installed an Agile Offroad RIP suspension kit that comes with upgraded shocks, rear leaf springs, and more.
At the rear, you'll come across an Owl Vans B2 carrier with a Monster 40 cargo box. A lot of specialized converters install flares on premium Sprinter-based camper vans – you'll also notice them on this rig.
Photo: YouTube Screenshot / Activan Flares, also known as pods or capsules, are designed to increase the van width to allow you to fit a bed inside in an east to west arrangement instead of the standard north to south. This rig's Vanspeed capsules are paint matched to the van's body and come with half-slider windows.
The most significant exterior mod is on top of the van: a Super Pacific Cloud Cap tent. It has a solid, weatherproof construction with a T-Slot frame and a marine-grade canvas, as well as three zipped windows and a decently sized mattress that can accommodate two people. What's more, its frame holds a Fiamma F45S awning and a front-facing LED light bar.
The rugged exterior look morphs into a luxurious, comfortable interior design. It has a nautical theme, hence the Land Yacht name.
You'll be greeted by a superb mix of holly and teak wood flooring (like you'd see in some yachts ), white shiplap walls, navy blue laminated cabinetry, and a slatted cherry wood ceiling. The look is complemented by a butcher block countertop with a custom stain and gold accents, such as the cabinet or drawer handles.
Photo: YouTube Screenshot / Activan You'll notice that the interior has an open layout, with no wall separating the driver's cabin from the living space. What's more, the two seats in the cabin are mounted on swivel bases, so they can be turned around to face the back of the van.
Two additional seating options are available straight ahead as you enter the van. Activan added two captain's chairs, complete with swivel bases and armrests.
Above, you'll discover two overhead cabinets and the pass-through that leads into the Cloud Cap rooftop tent. To get to the pass-through, you'll need to use a telescoping ladder.
Next, we have the kitchen, which is split into two units, one on each side. It features a deep black stainless steel sink with a pull-out tap, a single-burner induction stovetop, a massive residential-size fridge with a tiny freezer compartment, and a multi-function oven.
Photo: YouTube Screenshot / Activan A large overhead cabinet with a "floating" magnetic spice rack underneath, six drawers, and a cabinet underneath the sink are available for storage. The latter hides an 11-gallon (41-liter) greywater tank for the sink.
A bathroom sits on the driver's side, hidden behind a large conventional door – it's relatively spacious, measuring 36 inches (91 centimeters) in length. The bathroom offers a shower with a handheld wand and a Laveo dry-flush toilet. There's also an L-Track up top that you can use to attach hooks and hang items to dry or store.
Not only is the bathroom practical, but it also looks beautiful. It has matte marble finished walls paired with a gold shower fixture and a teak mat.
Like in most camper vans, the rear part of the interior is taken up by a fixed bed arrangement. It has a queen-size bed with a memory foam mattress, two overhead cabinets, and a ceiling A/C unit.
Photo: YouTube Screenshot / Activan Underneath the bed, Activan devised a garage that's accessible from both inside and outside the van. It offers abundant storage space in the middle, while its sides are occupied by two tall boxes that accommodate the utility systems.
Power is on the right side – the electrical system's highlights are a 300 Ah battery bank and a 3,000 W inverter. The company can add batteries for a total maximum capacity of 1,000 Ah.
As for plumbing, the van is equipped with a 42-gallon (159-liter) freshwater tank, a 20-gallon (76-liter) greywater tank mounted underneath the vehicle, and an outdoor shower with a quick connect.
All in all, the Land Yacht by Activan blends fine aesthetics with much-needed practicality. It can be the ideal adventure machine, especially if you want to go off-grid and roam for longer periods.
